decoder: Existing HMM strength 0.5 with priors fitted only to own four train matches; no recalibration or search.
training: Continue the original unweighted 8-epoch local head to12 and16; same AdamW and full RNG. No teacher/embedding training or exports. CPU only.
selection: For each fold choose highest robust own-validation spellF1 among caps passing prior promotion/safeguards versus8 and teacher, plus direct HA false-transition increase <=0.1/min versus8. Ties preserve8. Also record unconstrained robust best. Seal both before new test inference.
expansion: Recommend further work only if the same extended budget passes both own-fold validation gates. Otherwise close 8/12/16 investigation and analyze D/HMM as diagnostics, without test-driven promotion.
transition_matching: Official one-to-one typed pair, +/-12 native25Hz frames (0.48 s). Report all, direct HA and D-related transitions separately; D restarts never count as direct HA.
diagnostic_oracles: Analysis only, after selection seal. Perfect alive or conditional team at10Hz anchors, unchanged HMM and priors. Not train features, selection, or deployable predictions.
official_assets: Prohibited, including availability checks; explicit public external reports and IDSSE processed paths only. Historical sources and artifacts read only.
